target_customer: Biopharma companies and biotech teams needing research, analysis and strategy reports
problem: Drug development decisions need molecule design, analyses and strategy work that normally takes consultants and scientists months.
business_model: Per-engagement AI-generated reports and analyses (3 to 5 day turnaround)
product_category: AI biopharma research and strategy services

founders.name: Daniel Gomari
education: Stanford, PhD in computational biology (per YC page)
founders.background_notes: YC page: machine learning for drug repurposing and multi-omics on aging.

founders.name: Michael Snyder
founders.background_notes: Quinn site names him co-founder and Professor of Genetics at Stanford; not listed on the YC page.

technical_complexity.rationale: Delivering credible biopharma analyses and molecule designs requires domain models and expert validation, though much relies on third-party models.

defensibility.rationale: Report services rely on general AI tools and expert time; limited proprietary data was visible.

market_need_then: Consultancies and AI drug discovery firms were active in 2022 but a 3 to 5 day turnaround offering was not documented in sources found.

identity.voice_and_tone: Direct, confident, plain; 'Results in days', 'Your IP stays yours'

brand_strength.rationale: No press or community found; very common given name.

pivots.from: iollo, consumer at-home metabolomics blood test (launch post 'Live Healthier and Much Longer')
pivots.why: Not stated. The YC page for Quinn and a separate iollo YC page both exist and the relationship is not explained.

outcome_analysis: Quinn (quinnbio.com, a product of iollo, Inc.) is a small Stanford-linked company that sells AI-generated biopharma analyses in days. The YC page lists it active with five people, but no funding, press or exit was found, so there is no clear success or failure story. Credibility rests on the founders' Stanford ties and logos of research organizations, with no verified revenue.
notes: Aggregators (CB Insights, PitchBook) list $500K convertible note or seed for iollo around Sept 2022 with Paradox Capital and Palrecha Capital; unverified, not recorded as a round. Whether iollo and Quinn are the same entity or a pivot is inferred from the Quinn site ('product of iollo, Inc.') and YC X handle. No dated competitor found for AI biopharma analysis in mid 2022 so the list is empty. Customer logos on site are not confirmed paying customers. Completeness pass: the 500K convertible note around 2022-09 is recorded from CB Insights and PitchBook as reported for iollo, which is linked to Quinn only by inference from the Quinn site. PitchBook also lists Fundament, Goodwater Capital and Hummingbird as iollo investors, not tied to a dated round. No press source found.
